pages.title: Concentrated Solid E-710
pages.text: E-710 is a peculiar substance extracted from the remains of arthropods—spiders, cave spiders, silverfish, endermites, bees, and others—that die while standing on a subspace. Its fluid form has proven capable of stable warp travel when combined with position-chip technology. One piece of Concentrated Solid E-710 can be processed through Create's draining system into 1000 mB of E-710. Increasing production and prospecting for new E-710 sources have become critical priorities for interstellar logistics.
